home-page.welcome-text-body:
How wonderful that you stopped by. This page has been created as a comprehensive introduction to who I am—both when I'm wearing my work clothes and when I'm pursuing my personal interests.
Here, you can delve into my professional journey and skills if you are here for work purposes, or explore my blog. On the blog, I share thoughts, ideas, and topics that I find inspiring and valuable to share with the world.
I hope you find what you are looking for!

profile.profile-text-body: I hold a Master’s degree in Information Technology with solid experience in full-stack development and a specialization in artificial intelligence. I am passionate about artificial intelligence and software development, as well as how these fields can be used to create real social value. Personally, I thrive in interdisciplinary teams that offer autonomy and the opportunity to shape projects from concept to execution.

items.listItemBody: Implemented integrations with existing health platforms.
Implemented a cross-platform notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Designed and implemented the GraphQL API layer, schemas, efficient server-side resolvers, and optimized client-side queries for performance.
Implemented new features from initial concept and database design through to implementation.
Built and maintained responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
Utilized Azure DevOps to track sprint progress, manage backlogs, and ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks.
